signature: square of 101 mounds with diagonals

name: Turgay triradial (calibration)

name: Kite, Harrat al-Harrah (calibration, unverified)

name: Kite, Khaybar (calibration, unverified)
signature: kite walls on basalt
one_line: Second app example; also 25.742162,39.292586

name: Kostanay Tetragon (calibration, approx)
signature: trapezoid of eroded mounds in chernozem
one_line: Dey, reported in press: 1.9 km from Zatobolsk along the M36

name: Agade/Akkad at Tell Sinker (relict Tigris belt)

name: Agade at paleo-Adhaim/relict-Tigris junction (Balad-Ad Dujayl)

name: Irisagrig (CIGS point / Tall Warish)
signature: low 2-4 m mound field pock-marked by looting pits on NW-SE relict levee

name: Itj-tawy, floodplain E of Lisht pyramids
signature: buried ~5 m under Nile alluvium; no surface expression; needs coring/ERT
one_line: 12th Dynasty capital: town centre beneath cultivation E of Amenemhat I and Senusret I pyramids; MK layer at 5 m in cores

name: Tarhuntassa at Turkmen-Karahoyuk (DEM-derived mound, verify identity)
signature: round tell ~550 m, ~30 m high (24 ha >2 m), lower town >=80 ha, 2.9 km W of Cumra
one_line: Massa/Osborne candidate (Hartapu inscription, LBA 60-80 ha, Kurunti-ziti seal); contested by Hawkins-Weeden (Hulaya frontier)

name: Musasir/Ardini at Mudjesir (Mdjeser) near Sidakan
signature: temple terrace with column bases in mountain valley village; needs sub-metre imagery
one_line: Haldi column bases and life-size statues reported at Mdjeser; approximate coordinate, replace with village point

name: Thinis at Girga / el-Birba
signature: buried under modern town and floodplain silt; no orbital signature
one_line: First Dynasty capital; consensus Girga/el-Birba, 17 km from Abydos royal tombs

name: Wassukanni at Tell Fekheriye (Ras al-Ain)
signature: ~1 km mound complex partly under Ras al-Ain town; DEM ~14 m
one_line: Mittani capital candidate backed by Bonatz/Novak; NAA clay result and no texts argue against

name: Tarhuntassa southern alternative (Karaman-Karadag-Kizildag)
signature: capital-size LBA mound (>20 ha) on Karaman plain or acropolis on volcanic flank
one_line: If TKH is the Hulaya frontier, the capital lies south: Karadag/Kizildag Hartapu zone or Goksu valley

name: Agade at Samarra/Qadisiyya (Reade 2002)
signature: buried beneath Abbasid Samarra ruin field; not separable
one_line: Reade's Tigris-near-Qadisiyah/Samarra proposal; weak against Sippar-Khafajah itinerary

name: Ho-lao-lo-kia (曷劳落迦) sand-buried city search box
signature: partly sand-filled walled town 200-500 m; dark sherd/slag tati patches 0.1-2 km2 in interdune corridors; dead-poplar channel lines
one_line: Xuanzang: north of Khotan kingdom, survivor fled east to Pi-mo (Uzun-tati), already a sand mound in 644; DEM puts Pi-mo's distal fan here

name: Xuanzang's old Tukhara walled town, western Endere fan
signature: rammed-earth enclosure 100-300 m, round/square, possible stupa mound
one_line: 400-li/600-li circles (282 m/li calibrated on Khotan-Pi-mo) intersect 12 km W of the post-Xuanzang Tang fort, on the DEM fan axis

name: Northern Keriya trunk-axis terminal settlements beyond Yuansha
signature: dead-channel vegetation lines, sherd scatters, small enclosures 50-150 m, possible km-scale fields
one_line: DEM trunk axis threading Yuansha-Karadong continues N; pre-Yuansha terminus settlements expected here (alt point 39.20,81.30)

name: Lower Keriya-Niya interfluve successor to Karadong
signature: settlement cluster on dead channels; fields; confusable with modern Darya Boyi pastoral sites
one_line: Yuansha->Karadong SE migration extrapolated + Niya-ruins flow line converge east of Karadong

name: Song Yun's Mo city (末城), 22 li E of Hanmo/Pi-mo
signature: small walled town or tati spread at oasis edge
one_line: 22 li x 282 m/li east of Uzun-tati; likely within the known Domoko/Damagou cluster - cannot resolve

name: Uzun-tati = Pi-mo (calibration)
signature: tati debris field
one_line: Sets Xuanzang li = 282 m; exposes the Pi-mo->Ni-jang 200-li contradiction

name: Yuansha and Karadong (calibration)
signature: ring wall ~300 m (Yuansha); Karadong 44.6 km at az 146
one_line: Dated NW->SE settlement migration used for C3/C4

name: Endere Tang fort and Dandan Oilik (exclusion anchors)
signature: walled fort; Dandan Oilik at 37.7744,81.0731
one_line: Post-644 fort excluded as Tukhara city; 6th-8th c. Dandan Oilik excluded as Ho-lao-lo-kia

name: Chinguetti iron hill: unsurveyed SW/S Les Boucles megadune fronts
signature: Buried iron mass ~100x40 m at SW (lee) foot of >40 m dunes; targets LB-SW1..5 W-edges (e.g. 20.3471,-12.4549; 20.3804,-12.4238). If exposed: dark block on pale dune foot. Decisive test: PRISM-I aeromag or foot magnetometer.
one_line: Per-dune walk lines for the unsurveyed Les Boucles dunes that Warren et al. 2024 left open; matches Ripert's original 'SW'.

name: Chinguetti iron hill: NW Batraz megadunes
one_line: Only high-dune ground that fits Ripert's corrected SE bearing, the blacksmith's ~46 km 'half-way' distance and the 50 km camel limit together.

name: Linares blacksmiths' house-sized iron block near Chinguetti-Ouadane midpoint / 60 m ENE ridge
signature: 5-10 m dark block, possible slag/hearth spoil (sub-metre needed); nearby 20 km NNW-SSE ridge 50-60 m high (20.75,-11.93 to 20.57,-11.83): S2 tone check sand vs rock.
one_line: Warren et al. tested the blacksmiths' account 12-22 km E; the literal midpoint (46 km ENE) and an unexamined 60 m ridge 54 km ENE were never surveyed.

name: Ahnet-Tidikelt terminal basin (Sebkha Mekerrhane?) southern inflow delta highstand shoreline
signature: Closed basin floor 116 m, spill ~174 m (~9,500 km2 at highstand); 17,213 km2 wadi enters at 175 m contour; shoreline tone bands/diatomite S2-visible, sites need sub-metre. Secondary NE inflow 26.68,1.94.
one_line: DEM-derived 9,000 km2 highstand basin in the Ahnet region; its main inflow deltas are the best Holocene shoreline-site targets (novelty check not completed).

name: Zerzura per Wilkinson: sub-sea-level lake depressions 170-220 km W/NW of the Farafra-Bahariya track
signature: Closed depressions floor -9 to -69 m, 194-602 km2 (28.715,26.753; 28.830,27.155; 28.973,26.686); salt lakes and palm/reed patches S2-visible; ruins need sub-metre.
one_line: Wilkinson's original 'five days west of the Farafra-Bahariya track' points ~500 km north of the Gilf, at the spring-fed lake-oasis chain between Bahariya and Siwa.

name: Zerzura consensus wadis, Gilf Kebir (calibration); largest DEM catchment trunk
signature: N-S trunk wadi, 2,269 km2 catchment at 24.50N; acacia lines in 0.2-1 km wide floor; main-plateau N system exits at 24.124,25.998 (1,587 km2).
one_line: KNOWN Zerzura wadis; DEM runoff ranking says the northern-plateau trunk (likely Abd el Melik) and the 24.12N/26.00E system are the best-watered.

name: Bolaven buried crater (AAT source)
signature: buried under <0.8 Ma basalt; convex summit dome in DEM, no rim; gravity low
one_line: Sieh 2020 site; new test: reversed-polarity in-situ flows inside outline must date 773-788 ka or crater is falsified

name: Central Laos Muong Nong cluster
signature: if unburied: eroded 15-45 km basin/partial ring, 100-300 m relief in Khorat sandstone
one_line: Geometric median of literature MN-type tektite finds; a DEM check can falsify an exposed crater here

name: Gulf of Tonkin / Yinggehai basin floor
signature: submerged, sediment-buried; seismic only
one_line: Whymark 2021 site; fits microtektites only with SSW asymmetry

name: Tonle Sap
signature: alluvial lake basin, no DEM expression
one_line: Hartung & Koeberl 1994; matches symmetric microtektite best fit (12N 105.75E) but far from MN tektites

name: Leizhou-N Hainan basalt field
signature: buried under Quaternary basalt; test with gravity
one_line: Bolaven analogue inside the monazite triangle near S China MN tektites; weak

name: Badain Jaran megadune-lake area
signature: buried under megadunes; gravity/magnetic anomaly
one_line: Karimi 2023; contradicted by loess and Beijing nulls and microtektite fit (never selected in 500 bootstraps)

name: LDG source: BP/Oasis dating test
signature: BP 2 km and Oasis 18 km ring structures 117-151 km W of LDG field

name: Al Madafi structure
signature: 6 km circular structure in arid exposed rock
one_line: Most field-testable untested proposed structure (shatter cones / PDF sampling)

name: Unnamed massif 20 km E of Mount Mabu (Lugela, Zambezia)

name: Unnamed massif 37 km E of Mount Mabu
signature: 2-4 km2 closed tall canopy on a 1145 m massif (868 m relief)
one_line: Third forested massif in the Mabu cluster; weak but above-baseline tall-canopy signal.

name: Massif 17 km SE of Chiperone summit
signature: 3-5 km2 tall canopy on S/SE slopes of a 1409 m dome (1113 m relief)
one_line: Possible sister sky island to Chiperone; may already be covered by Chiperone surveys.

name: Forested massif at -15.72, 37.25 (possibly Mount Lico)
signature: 3-4 km2 tall canopy on a 1562 m massif (962 m relief)
one_line: Identity unresolved: either Mount Lico (KNOWN, positive control) or a new forested inselberg nearby.

name: Mount Mabu (calibration)
signature: 10-20 km2 tall closed canopy; CHM >20 m on 16.6% of core box vs 0.6% miombo
one_line: Reference forest used to calibrate the canopy-height detector.

name: Serra Mecula, Niassa (context)
signature: weak tall-canopy signal (0.7 km2 >20 m) on 1436 m massif
one_line: Known surveyed massif that barely registers; shows the detector's false-negative floor.

name: Darai Plateau giant closed doline

name: S06E142 deep doline (Hela)
signature: 138 m deep, ~260 m mid-depth, TanDEM-X floor
one_line: Robust 138 m deep round doline in PNG highland karst

name: Northern Nakanai void-filled pit

name: S06E142 escarpment waterfall

name: Alpine pit at 2560 m (Hela)
signature: 116 m deep, ~210 m mid-depth, steep walls

name: Sarisarinama third flattened sima (calibration)

name: A6 Iñapari–Iberia tri-border box (PE/BO/BR)

name: A4 RO–AM–MT tri-border box (Machadinho–Colniza)
signature: Ditched enclosures in pasture; box N-9.0 S-9.5 W-60.9 E-60.4
one_line: Bridges Madeira and NW-MT clusters; 454 km2 cleared 2019-24, nearest known 64 km

name: A5 north-of-Cujubim box (RO)

name: M1 Baures–Casarabe gap box (Llanos de Mojos)

name: COP-DEM giant-mound anomaly P3, Calakmul–Río Bec gap
signature: Compact 3x3-px ~20 m bump in GLO-30 DSM under continuous forest, Calakmul-like profile
one_line: DSM top-hat calibrated on Calakmul/Mirador/Nakbé; novelty UNCHECKED, may be a registered site or karst hill

name: M3 Beni south of Riberalta box
signature: Ring ditches in cleared/burned forest; box N-11.8 S-12.3 W-66.2 E-65.7
one_line: 552 km2 loss 2022-24, 90-100 km south of Riberalta ring-ditch cluster

name: Ghana royal town al-Ghaba: NNW low-plain sector 9-12 km from Koumbi Saleh
signature: Ruin field of low (1-3 m) earth/stone-rubble mounds, lighter tone than grassland, possible tumuli 10-30 m; check WorldCover built pixels at 15.8239,-7.9902 and 15.846,-8.019 and depressions at 15.855,-8.008 / 15.853,-7.963
one_line: al-Bakri's 6 miles (8.9-11.8 km) + the DEM low plain (233-245 m) NW-N of Koumbi Saleh + closed-depression water points converge on an arc centred at 15.846,-8.017.

name: Njimi (Kanem capital) = Tie fired-brick enclosure
signature: 3.2 ha reddish fired-brick enclosure and rubble mounds amid ~11 smaller satellite sites on pale sandy grassland
one_line: DAI/Frobenius identification (largest brick site, local name Njimi-ye, 11th-14th c. dates) placed about 45 km E of Mao (WorldCover-verified) gives 14.121,15.729.

name: La Navidad (1492) at En Bas Saline, Limonade, Haiti
signature: Large Taino town of low middens/mounds with a central mound (burned 1492 structure); fort not resolvable from orbit
one_line: Diario 1.5 leagues to the village + 1 league from Picolet put the Santa Maria wreck offshore at ~19.80,-72.143, consistent with En Bas Saline (Deagan's 1492 burned structure) as La Navidad.

name: Mali capital, Sansara=Sankarani reading: Niger-Sankarani wedge opposite Kangaba
signature: Earth-built town mounds on a floodplain margin; needs sub-metre/lidar
one_line: If the Sansara is the Sankarani (confluence 12.01,-8.33), 'ten miles' beyond a crossing near its mouth lands 15-20 km SW in the wedge, 2-8 km from the Kangaba candidate.

name: Mali capital, Hunwick Niger left-bank corridor Bamako-Segou
signature: Earth-built town mounds; corridor too long for orbital search without a narrower constraint
one_line: Hunwick's corridor fits a 23-27 km/day 24-day itinerary but is 80-275 km from the Sankarani, so it needs the Sansara to be another stream; the two readings cannot both hold.

name: Fort Caroline (1564), St Johns Bluff vicinity
signature: Small earth-and-timber fort, possibly eroded into the channel; no orbital signature
one_line: 'South side, six miles from the mouth' measures to 6.2 mi (10.0 km at 260 deg) from the WorldCover river mouth to the bluff forest, matching the traditional (NPS) vicinity; Altamaha/St Marys alternatives are untested.

name: Roanoke Lost Colony Site X, Bertie County
signature: Subsurface artifact scatter; no surface relief
one_line: Virginea Pars patch fort symbol + Border-ware finds at Site X/Y on the western Albemarle shore, about 90 km (56 mi) W of Fort Raleigh; coordinate approximate.

name: Mabila (1540) battle town, Alabama-Tombigbee Forks (alt. Marengo Co. 32.25,-87.80)
signature: Burned palisaded town under forest; needs lidar and metal detection
one_line: Two published claims (southern Clarke Co. Forks vs UWA Marengo Co.) lie 123 km apart; no convergence; battle signature not yet found at either.

name: Central-Yamal GEC cluster search box A (69.93-70.20N, 68.30-69.15E)
signature: new dark pit 20-70 m with bright ejecta ring; compare 2024-07-29 / 2025-08-18 / 2026-08-18 (42WVC)
one_line: 4-5 of ~8 giant GECs (C1,C2,C9,C17,C22) cluster here near Bovanenkovo pipeline; next GEC most likely here; our 2025-26 S2 scan found none

name: C22 'Doublet' GEC, S2-derived location
signature: dark pit with bright rim ~230 m NE of C2; absent 2023-06-30, present 2023-09-05
one_line: Calibration: 2023 crater recovered in 10 m S2, formation window 2023-06-30..2023-09-05

name: Lhende Khola 2026 landslide-dam / barrier-lake site
signature: grey debris fan blocking valley at DEM 2873-2947 m; compare S2 2025-10-21 vs 2026-09-28/10-26 (45RUM)
one_line: CCTV 2950 m + >10 km from Gyirong Port + S2 debris junction + DEM converge here; no lake persisted by late Sep 2026

name: Langtang Lirung north-face ice-rock avalanche, 26 Aug 2026
signature: fresh light-grey track 4-5 km long from ice to valley; S2 2025-10-21 vs 2026-10-26
one_line: M5.2-equivalent seismic signal; deadly Nepal-Tibet debris flow; S2 before/after confirmed

name: Mt King George / Hubbard Glacier co-seismic landslides (Dec 2025)
signature: rock-ice debris sheets on glacier, largest 9 km2, 7.4 km runout; first optical view summer 2026
one_line: >700 slides mapped by SAR only; compare S2 Sep 2025 vs Jul-Sep 2026 (coords approx.)

name: Kamchatka M8.8 coastal-cliff/cloud-gap landslides
signature: fresh scars and talus fans on Pacific coastal cliffs missed by USGS inventory
one_line: USGS 346-slide inventory admits missing coastal rockfall and cloud-covered areas; compare Jul 2025 vs Sep 2025/Jun 2026 (coords approx.)

name: NE Greenland post-2020 new islands (Storstrommen / Zachariae fronts)
signature: rock islands separated from retreating ice front by water/melange; Aug 2020 vs Aug 2025-26
one_line: Kavan et al. 2025 inventory stops at 2020; Pelto notes unnamed islands released at Storstrommen (coords approx.)

name: Talidas GLOF source lake and Ghizer River blockage (Aug 2025)
signature: drained moraine lake basin + debris fan in Ghizer channel; 7-8 km temporary lake for hours
one_line: Intermittent lake likely absent from GLOF inventories; check refilling Jul 2025 vs Sep 2025/Sep 2026 (coords approx.)

name: Seyakha GEC search box B
signature: new pit with ejecta near river channels/pingo-like mounds (42WXD)
one_line: Around 2017 Seyakha blowout crater C11; compare Jul 2023 vs Aug 2026

name: Gydan AntGEC search box C
signature: new pit with ejecta (43WET)
one_line: Around 2013 AntGEC on poorly monitored Gydan; compare 2020 vs 2026 summers

name: Tracy Arm landslide, 10 Aug 2025 (calibration)
signature: ~1 km scar above South Sawyer Glacier, 481 m tsunami trimline
one_line: M5.4-equivalent signal, >64 Mm3; compare Jul 2025 vs Sep 2025 (coords approx.)

name: Prow Knob new island, Alsek Lake (calibration)
signature: knob fully surrounded by water after glacier separation
one_line: Became an island between 2025-07-13 and 2025-08-06 (coords approx.)
